meta.title: Dog Store Pro
meta.description: Duty equipment for working dogs. Patrol, scent work, training.

hero.title: Dogs that work under <accent>load</accent>
hero.body: Equipment for patrol duty, scent work and training. A service dog loads a collar differently than a family dog — so the webbing, hardware and stitching here are specified to different figures.

field.label: Field testing
field.body: A new item goes to handlers first and works with dogs through a full season. Only what comes back without a burst seam or a battered fitting goes on sale.

spec.label: Specifications
spec.body: For every item we state break strength and weight in grams. If a collar weighs 168 g and lets go at 380 kg, that stands in the spec sheet — not behind the word durable.

service.label: Service
service.body: We repair seams and replace hardware in-house, with no need to send gear back to the maker. The collar returns to duty instead of waiting out a quarter in a warranty queue.

categoryPage.emptyBody: You will find the rest of the Dog Store Pro line in the categories on the bar above.

meta.title: Request for quote
meta.description: Request for quote on Dog Store Pro equipment for units, kennels and training schools. Pricing, lead times, marking.

inquiry.heading: Request for quote
inquiry.intro: A form for units, kennels and training schools ordering equipment in larger quantities or needing marking. Single catalog items you buy the usual way, through the cart.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.body: We reply within two business days. The quote states unit price, lead time and the cost of marking.

marking.title: Marking
marking.body: Unit patches, numbers and ID panels are sewn in-house. We confirm the design before production.

leadTime.title: Lead times
leadTime.body: Catalog items ship from stock. Orders with marking are fulfilled in 10 to 15 business days.

settlement.title: Payment terms
settlement.body: Invoice with deferred payment for units and institutions. Prepayment for everyone else.

form.deadlinePlaceholder: e.g. by the end of the quarter
form.catalogIntro: Set quantities on the items you want in the quote. You can leave them empty and describe your needs in the notes.
